parameters.name: DomainRecordInfo
parameters.description: The data for the batch operation.

sub_parameters.name: Domain
sub_parameters.description:
The domain name.

> A single request can contain up to 200 entries. Exceeding this limit may cause the request to fail due to the HTTP request header size limit.

sub_parameters.name: Line
sub_parameters.description: The resolution line. Default value: default.

sub_parameters.name: NewRr
sub_parameters.description: The new host record. This parameter is used only for modification operations and is for internal use only.

sub_parameters.name: NewType
sub_parameters.description: The new record type. This parameter is used only for modification operations and is for internal use only.

sub_parameters.name: NewValue
sub_parameters.description: The new record value. This parameter is used only for modification operations and is for internal use only.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description:
The MX priority.

This parameter is required if the record type is MX. Default value: 10.

sub_parameters.name: Rr
sub_parameters.description:
The host record.

> This parameter is required when `Type` is **RR\_ADD** or **RR\_DEL**.

sub_parameters.name: Ttl
sub_parameters.description: The TTL, in seconds. Default value: ***600***.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The record type. Examples: A, AAAA, TXT, MX, and CNAME.

> This parameter is required when `Type` is **RR\_ADD** or **RR\_DEL**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The record value.

> This parameter is required when `Type` is **RR\_ADD** or **RR\_DEL**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The response language. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: zh

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The batch operation type. Valid values:

- **DOMAIN\_ADD**: adds domain names in batches.

- **DOMAIN\_DEL**: deletes domain names in batches.

- **RR\_ADD**: adds DNS records in batches.

- **RR\_DEL**: deletes DNS records in batches. This operation deletes DNS records that match the conditions specified by `Rr`, `Value`, or both. If you do not specify `Rr` and `Value`, all DNS records for the specified domain name are deleted.
